title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
summary: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush is a 2026 racing game from the developers behind Hot Wheels Unleashed & Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged. Developed and published by Milestone S.r.l., the game has been released on 10 September 2026, for the Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2 and Microsoft Windows.

title: Peterbilt
summary: Peterbilt Motors Company is an American truck manufacturer specializing in the production of heavy-duty (Class 8) and medium-duty (Classes 5–7) commercial vehicles. The namesake of company founder T. "Al" Peterman, it was established in 1939 from the acquisition of Fageol Truck and Motor Company, and has operated as part of PACCAR since 1958.

title: Rev-Ups (2011)
summary:
thumb|200px 
Rev-Ups were a line of vehicles with a friction motor and magnets on the chassis. The bodies are interchangeable between chassis. This series was a reboot of the earlier Micro Rev-Ups from 2003.

title: Hot Wheels Classics
summary:
200px|right
